message.content: All three in-scope claims (FP32 error budget on adversarial extrema, div_rn correct rounding, shared-storage aliasing) are rebutted by direct runtime probes with strong margins (max error ratio ≤0.31 of tolerance, bit-exact division on 1M samples, clean aliasing cases).
